title: Boundaries and seeking support in your psychology career - DClinpsy - Assistant Psychologist - PWP

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱以外的收入，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士（Dr. Marianne Trent），自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特（Sophie Foote）的“一对多”课程现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该课程，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的学习旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特纳姆和梅森（Fortnum and Mason）的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: Coming up in today's episode of Marianne's Summer Soundbites, we are looking at two more brilliant strategies to help you to nourish yourself, to nurture yourself,
sentences.zh: 在今天这期《玛丽安的夏季短讯》中，我们将探讨另外两个绝妙的策略，帮助你滋养自己、呵护自己，

sentences.en: to look after yourself, treat yourself as number one.
sentences.zh: 照顾好自己，把自己放在第一位。

sentences.en: So you can reduce the chance of burnout and be there for your clients, your families, or everybody else too.
sentences.zh: 这样你就能减少职业倦怠的可能性，并能更好地支持你的客户、家人以及其他所有人。

sentences.en: Hope you find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这很有用。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: Welcome along to another episode of the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听新一期的《有抱负的心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: This is another of our super useful, super punchy,
sentences.zh: 这是我们又一期超级实用、超级精炼、

sentences.en: shorter-than-usual summer soundbite episodes so that you can keep psychology in your day-to-day life when you might be a little bit busier.
sentences.zh: 比平时更短的夏季短讯节目，这样即使在你比较忙碌的时候，也能让心理学常伴你的日常生活。

sentences.en: So another series which has been really popular in the past is the free Compassionate Q&A series.
sentences.zh: 过去非常受欢迎的另一个系列是免费的“富有同情心的问答”系列。

sentences.en: And they're hosted all by me and they're all, as I said, absolutely for free across my socials.
sentences.zh: 它们全由我主持，正如我所说，在我的社交媒体上完全免费。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent everywhere, but a great place to catch up with it is either via YouTube, which is Dr. Marianne Trent, or via my free Facebook group,
sentences.zh: 我在各处都叫玛丽安·特伦特博士，但了解它的好地方要么是通过YouTube（搜索Dr. Marianne Trent），要么是通过我的免费Facebook群组，

sentences.en: which is the Aspiring Psychologist Community with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 即“有抱负的心理学家社区与玛丽安·特伦特博士”。

sentences.en: Right, let me tell you and talk you through the dates where you can grab these really useful sessions if you are applying for psychology doctorate programs in the autumn.
sentences.zh: 好了，让我来告诉你并带你了解一下，如果你在秋季申请心理学博士课程，可以在哪些日期参加这些非常有用的会议。

sentences.en: So I know that is the case for D-ClinSci and that is the case for educational psychology too.
sentences.zh: 我知道临床心理学博士（D-ClinSci）是这样，教育心理学也是如此。

sentences.en: So the first of those sessions is running on Monday, the 4th of September, 2023 at 6pm.
sentences.zh: 第一场会议将于2023年9月4日星期一晚上6点举行。

sentences.en: The second is Tuesday, the 3rd of October, 2023 at 6pm.
sentences.zh: 第二场是2023年10月3日星期二晚上6点。

sentences.en: And the last, but certainly not the least, is Tuesday, the 7th of November, 2023 at 6pm.
sentences.zh: 最后，但同样重要的一场是2023年11月7日星期二晚上6点。

sentences.en: And like I said, runs across all of my social platforMs.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，它会在我所有的社交平台上进行。

sentences.en: So put a note in your diary and join me then.
sentences.zh: 所以请在你的日记里记下来，到时候加入我。

sentences.en: But if you're not free that day, you can catch any replays on Dr. Marianne Trent on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 但如果你那天没空，你可以在YouTube上的Dr. Marianne Trent频道观看重播。

sentences.en: And whilst you're there, why not like and subscribe, share a bit of useful content and drop me some comments.
sentences.zh: 当你去那里时，何不点赞、订阅、分享一些有用的内容并给我留言呢？

sentences.en: So let's plough on with the first of my strategies today for how to keep you tip top and therefore to help your clients really benefit and those around you too.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们继续今天第一个策略，关于如何让你保持最佳状态，从而真正帮助你的客户以及你周围的人。

sentences.en: So the first is, for me, it's setting boundaries and knowing that that's okay to do.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，第一点是设定界限，并知道这样做是可以的。

sentences.en: And it's really important that you do.
sentences.zh: 而且你这样做非常重要。

sentences.en: Setting boundaries might look different for different people.
sentences.zh: 设定界限对不同的人来说可能看起来不同。

sentences.en: But certainly when I was an aspiring psychologist,
sentences.zh: 但当然，当我还是一个有抱负的心理学家时，

sentences.en: it meant sometimes that I was having to work a little bit later in order to get reports ready for the next day's ward round or the next day's care planning meetings.
sentences.zh: 这意味着有时我不得不工作得晚一点，以便为第二天早上的查房或第二天的护理计划会议准备好报告。

sentences.en: But I was on a system where flexi time was possible as well.
sentences.zh: 但我所在的系统也允许弹性工作制。

sentences.en: So I could still choose to come in at the same time the next day, but I could then log any extra time spent 15 minutes and over doing additional duties.
sentences.zh: 所以我仍然可以选择第二天在同一时间上班，但我可以记录任何超过15分钟的额外职责时间。

sentences.en: I could then take that back either just straight away the next day or I could save it up and take it as a bit of a longer chunk to have a bit of a morning off or to finish early one afternoon too.
sentences.zh: 然后我可以选择第二天直接补休，或者攒起来作为一个较长的时间段，休个半天假或某个下午早点下班。

sentences.en: Clearly, you're going to need to discuss that with your line manager and with your supervisor.
sentences.zh: 显然，你需要与你的直线经理和主管讨论这个问题。

sentences.en: And if that's not the policy in your department, then you might just need to be really bounded about your time,
sentences.zh: 如果你的部门没有这项政策，那么你可能只需要对你的时间设定严格的界限，

sentences.en: about your start and your finish times and make sure that you're not adding too much to your plate to do in any particular day.
sentences.zh: 关于你的开始和结束时间，并确保你在任何特定的一天里没有给自己增加太多的工作量。

sentences.en: And sometimes that can feel really tricky when you want to look keen, you want to look enthusiastic, you want to be helpful.
sentences.zh: 有时当你想要表现得积极、热情、乐于助人时，这可能会让人觉得非常棘手。

sentences.en: But sometimes you might need to just remind people of what you've already got on.
sentences.zh: 但有时你可能需要提醒人们你已经承担了什么。

sentences.en: So you might need to check the priority of what's being asked for you.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能需要检查被要求做的事情的优先级。

sentences.en: So when someone gives you a piece of work, you say, can I ask, you know, when you might need that back by, what your deadline is for that?
sentences.zh: 当有人给你分配工作时，你可以问：我可以问一下你什么时候需要这个吗？你的截止日期是什么时候？

sentences.en: And if they say, oh, today as soon as possible, then you might say, OK, I've already got this that we've agreed needs to be done by today and I'm working on that currently.
sentences.zh: 如果他们说，哦，今天越快越好，那么你可以说，好的，我已经有今天必须完成的工作了，我目前正在处理那个。

sentences.en: So could you let me know which has the highest priority because I need to finish at five today and then, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以你能告诉我哪个优先级最高吗？因为我今天五点必须结束工作，然后，你知道，

sentences.en: you're levelling with them that there's only one of you and that is honestly OK to do.
sentences.zh: 你是在向他们坦诚你只有一个人，而且这样做完全没问题。

sentences.en: It might take a little bit of a practice.
sentences.zh: 这可能需要一点练习。

sentences.en: It might take talking this through in the mirror, but that's OK.
sentences.zh: 可能需要对着镜子练习一下，但这没关系。

sentences.en: You aren't anybody's slave.
sentences.zh: 你不是任何人的奴隶。

sentences.en: You certainly, I certainly, we certainly don't get paid well enough to work 24-7 around the clock.
sentences.zh: 你当然，我当然，我们当然没有得到足够的报酬去24小时全天候工作。

sentences.en: And actually, when we try to do that, we recognise that we start to feel pretty jaded.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当我们尝试这样做时，我们意识到我们开始感到相当疲惫。

sentences.en: We start to feel pretty tired and we're no use to ourselves and we're certainly no use to the service.
sentences.zh: 我们开始感到相当疲倦，这对我们自己毫无用处，对服务也毫无用处。

sentences.en: And before you know it, you're looking for new jobs because you're working too hard and it's not working for you.
sentences.zh: 在你意识到之前，你就会因为工作太辛苦而寻找新工作，这并不适合你。

sentences.en: And it's likely not working for them.
sentences.zh: 而且这对他们来说可能也不起作用。

sentences.en: You might find that you're dropping all sorts of balls all over the place.
sentences.zh: 你可能会发现你到处都在丢球。

sentences.en: And I know in May last year, when we spoke to Rose Dunstan for the podcast, which was way back in episode 25,
sentences.zh: 我知道去年五月，当我们在播客中采访罗斯·邓斯坦（Rose Dunstan）时，那是在第25集，

sentences.en: she introduced us to the idea of glass and rubber balls with the idea that we could afford to drop some rubber balls.
sentences.zh: 她向我们介绍了玻璃球和橡胶球的概念，认为我们可以承受丢掉一些橡胶球。

sentences.en: But we probably couldn't and shouldn't be planning on dropping the glass ones because they're too important.
sentences.zh: 但我们可能不能也不应该计划丢掉玻璃球，因为它们太重要了。

sentences.en: And that's been a really helpful idea to myself, but also to a number of clients I've worked with as well.
sentences.zh: 这对我和我合作过的许多客户来说都是一个非常有用的想法。

sentences.en: So if you're listening to this, thank you so much, Rose, and hope that it's all going well with you.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你正在听这个，非常感谢你，罗斯，希望你一切顺利。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it might be helpful for you in your work capacity or in your study capacity, for that matter,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这可能对你的工作能力或学习能力有帮助，

sentences.en: and maybe even in your personal capacity to think about which of your priorities and which of the concerns in your life are rubber balls,
sentences.zh: 甚至在你的个人生活中，思考一下你生活中的哪些优先事项和担忧是橡胶球，

sentences.en: those you can afford to place down or to leave unattended or to just, you know, let drop, and which are glass balls, those which you can't.
sentences.zh: 那些你可以放下、不去管或者只是，你知道，让它掉落的，而哪些是玻璃球，那些你不能丢的。

sentences.en: So, yeah, let me know what you think.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，让我知道你的想法。

sentences.en: Do come along to the Aspiring Psychologist community or any of my social media posts and discuss this with me.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到“有抱负的心理学家”社区或我的任何社交媒体帖子，与我讨论这个问题。

sentences.en: What are your glass balls?
sentences.zh: 什么是你的玻璃球？

sentences.en: What are your rubber balls, so to speak?
sentences.zh: 可以说，什么是你的橡胶球？

sentences.en: Right, let's pause here for a quick break, and I'll be back along to talk through our next of our top tips for reducing burnout and keeping you vibrant.
sentences.zh: 好了，让我们在这里休息一下，稍后回来讨论我们减少职业倦怠和保持活力的下一个秘诀。

sentences.en: Welcome back along.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: I hope that jingle is firmly in your head and you're enjoying having it there.
sentences.zh: 希望那个叮当声已经牢牢印在你的脑海里，并且你很享受它。

sentences.en: So, in the first half, we were looking at how to set boundaries to help keep you well and to help keep your service and everything in your life ticking along nicely.
sentences.zh: 在前半部分，我们探讨了如何设定界限来帮助你保持健康，并帮助你的服务和生活中的一切顺利进行。

sentences.en: Now, we're going to look at the second of our Marianne's summer soundbite topics for the day.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们将看看今天《玛丽安的夏季短讯》的第二个主题。

sentences.en: Next, we are looking at the importance of seeking support and supervision.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们关注寻求支持和督导的重要性。

sentences.en: Please, at this point, don't let your eyes glaze over because it really is important.
sentences.zh: 请在这一点上，不要让你的眼睛感到疲倦，因为它真的很重要。

sentences.en: You know, the quality of the relationship between you and your supervisor, you and those in your team,
sentences.zh: 你知道，你和你的主管之间，你和团队成员之间的关系质量，

sentences.en: maybe even those you're sharing an office with, if that's something that you have.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能包括那些和你共用办公室的人，如果这是你的情况的话。

sentences.en: I know when I was an Aspiring Psychologist, sometimes I didn't even have my own chair.
sentences.zh: 我知道当我还是一个有抱负的心理学家时，有时我甚至没有自己的椅子。

sentences.en: Heck, when I was qualified, sometimes I didn't even have my own chair.
sentences.zh: 见鬼，当我获得资格时，有时我甚至没有自己的椅子。

sentences.en: But, you know, where you are, where you're spending your time day to day can be so important
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，你在哪里，你每天在哪里度过你的时间，这可能非常重要，

sentences.en: in the way that you're able to bring yourself to work, the way you're able to bring yourself to your client work and how much good stuff is left over at the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 这决定了你如何投入工作，如何投入客户工作，以及一天结束时还剩下多少精力。

sentences.en: So, it can be useful looking at when in the week you're having supervision because, of course, if you know that you're having it, I don't know,
sentences.zh: 所以，看看你在周几进行督导可能会很有用，因为当然，如果你知道你是在，我不知道，

sentences.en: first thing on a Monday morning or first thing on a Tuesday morning, but then you're going right through the week and you've got lots of tricky things stacking up,
sentences.zh: 周一早上第一件事或周二早上第一件事进行督导，但随后你整个星期都在忙碌，堆积了很多棘手的事情，

sentences.en: then it might not be super useful for you going home on a Friday all full up to the brim.
sentences.zh: 那么这对你周五回家时感到精疲力竭可能不是特别有用。

sentences.en: You know, it might be better if you're able to sit and have that chat with your supervisor about what you're experiencing when you clock off for the week
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你能在下班时与你的主管坐下来聊聊你的经历，可能会更好，

sentences.en: and how much of that you might be taking home.
sentences.zh: 以及你可能带回家了多少情绪。

sentences.en: Because, you know, we, I speak collectively as supervisors, past and present, don't want you being so full up that you can't engage with your day-to-day life.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，我们，我代表主管们，过去和现在，都不希望你因为太满而无法参与你的日常生活。

sentences.en: You know, I really would like for you to be able to do your job, do your job well whilst you're there, but then leave it there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我真的希望你能做好你的工作，在工作时做好，但之后就把工作留在那里。

sentences.en: You know, leave it in the phone, leave it in the spreadsheet, leave it in your laptop.
sentences.zh: 你知道，把它留在电话里，留在电子表格里，留在你的笔记本电脑里。

sentences.en: Don't bring that home with you because it's going to really affect your window of tolerance.
sentences.zh: 不要把它带回家，因为它会严重影响你的承受窗口。

sentences.en: It's going to make it terribly thin, terribly little, not much jam in the sandwich.
sentences.zh: 它会变得非常狭窄，非常小，三明治里没多少果酱。

sentences.en: And yeah, before you know it, you're going to be struggling with lots and lots of things.
sentences.zh: 是的，在你意识到之前，你就会陷入很多很多事情的挣扎中。

sentences.en: So making sure that you're contained.
sentences.zh: 所以要确保你被妥善安置。

sentences.en: And that is something that I got much better at doing as I got, as my career advanced, I found myself being able to kind of think about clients as and when I wanted to,
sentences.zh: 随着我的职业发展，我在这方面做得好多了，我发现自己能够根据需要去思考客户，

sentences.en: you know, either in a mindful way or because something I was doing or listening to or thinking of reminded me of them, but it felt pleasant to have them there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，要么是以一种正念的方式，要么是因为我正在做、正在听或正在想的事情让我想起了他们，但这种感觉很愉快。

sentences.en: It wasn't like it was pressing down on me and feeling really heavy or that they were unwelcome in some way.
sentences.zh: 这不像是在压迫我，感觉很沉重，或者他们以某种方式不受欢迎。

sentences.en: So yeah, it can be really useful to think about the timing of your supervision.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，考虑督导的时间安排真的很有用。

sentences.en: But also something I've really benefited from is the wisdom and the knowledge and the expertise of others in the team who might not even be psychologists.
sentences.zh: 但我也从团队中其他人的智慧、知识和专业技能中受益匪浅，他们甚至可能不是心理学家。

sentences.en: Not to make it sound like psychologists are the be all and end all, but of course this is an aspiring psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 并不是说心理学家就是一切，但当然这是一个《有抱负的心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: So you've got to give me a little bit of leeway there.
sentences.zh: 所以你得给我一点余地。

sentences.en: If you have time in your diary, especially at the beginning of a job, it can be wonderfully enriching and rewarding to shadow other members of the team
sentences.zh: 如果你的日程表上有时间，特别是在工作开始时，跟随团队的其他成员工作会非常丰富和有益，

sentences.en: or even to ask if you could, after you've shadowed a few, you know, run a session together, run an assessment together or go and help out at a therapy group.
sentences.zh: 甚至可以问问你是否可以在跟随几个人之后，一起进行一次会议、一起进行一次评估，或者去帮助一个治疗小组。

sentences.en: And because you'll learn so much, but also you'll be able to bring and offer your unique skills and talents.
sentences.zh: 因为你不仅会学到很多，而且你还能贡献和提供你独特的技能和才华。

sentences.en: And do bear in mind the supervision shaping tool, which is available from my website.
sentences.zh: 请记住我的网站上提供的“督导塑造工具”。

sentences.en: And people have said they've been finding really useful.
sentences.zh: 人们说他们发现它非常有用。

sentences.en: You can download that for yourself by going to the link in the show notes or the post description.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过点击节目说明或帖子描述中的链接自行下载。

sentences.en: But in case you're listening, you don't have a pen.

sentences.en: So that is it for Marianne's Summer Soundbites for today.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天《玛丽安的夏季短讯》的全部内容。

sentences.en: Hope you found it useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得它很有用。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: Please do subscribe, like, share, comment, tell your friends about us.

sentences.en: Share us on your socials.
sentences.zh: 在你的社交媒体上分享我们。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: And I'll be back along with the next episode of the Aspiring Psychologist podcast from Monday at 6 a.m.
sentences.zh: 我会在周一早上6点带着下一期《有抱负的心理学家》播客回来。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱以外的收入，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”课程现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该课程，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的学习旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特纳姆和梅森的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday, the 16th of November at 10 p.m.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。
